statement: Star Signs and Constellations unlock by reaching the map Where the Branch Ends and interacting with the telescope
Star Signs are unlocked by spending Star Points gained from completing Constellations around the world
You start with one Star Sign slot; Chronus Cosmos and Hydron Cosmos unlock up to three equipped at once
Each Constellation gives a set amount of star points
Not enough points exist in the game to unlock all Star Signs
Selectively choose which Star Signs to unlock and make sure they are necessary for your character's progression
A1 in Blunder Hills town top right of tree requires four characters reaching level 30
You must interact with the constellation on each of those characters for it to count as progress
A2 at top end of branch in Where the Branch Ends requires AFK offline over one hour before selecting the constellation
A3 at the bottom of Valley of the Beans near exit portal needs four players to reach and interact
A4 in Tucked Away at end of World 1 needs three players to reach and interact
A5 on bottom platform at end of The Sewers in The Office needs Dr Defecaus defeated on three players then interact
A6 at top of Freefall Caverns needs an Archer; that Archer needs level 10 Mining to access the map
A7 in Winding Willows needs two characters AFK 24 hours consecutively
A 24-hour time candy works for A7 but 12-hour candies do not since it must be 24 consecutive hours
A8 in Dew Drop Coliseum bottom right needs the coliseum cleared (all 15 rounds) on three players
Select the constellation on each of the three characters otherwise you do not get progress
A9 in Amarok Arena needs boss killed in under 20 seconds on three characters; constellation is behind him
A-10 in Echoing Egress needs reaching the constellation on any Mage class
Entering the A10 map requires level 40 Mining on that Mage class
B1 at the bottom of Mimic Hole needs three players to reach the star
B2 in Faraway Piers needs any Mage reaching the star; the Mage needs level 15 Fishing to enter
B3 in Grandioso Canyon near entrance needs AFK 36 hours consecutively on three players
B4 in Slamabam Straightaway bottom right needs four players to reach the star
B5 in Sandstone Coliseum needs all 15 rounds cleared on four players
Interact with the B5 star before leaving the Coliseum or progress is not completed
B6 in Efaunt Boss Room far left needs Efaunt killed by a beginner class (beginner Journeyman or Maestro)
B7 on the cactus at top middle of Up Down needs AFK 48 hours consecutively on three characters
B8 in YumYum Grotto town under fishing portal needs level 65 on four players and interacting on each
C1 in Frostbite Tundra under the World 4 portal needs level 90 on six characters and interacting on each
C2 in Steep Sheep Ledge bottom right needs a Sheepy defeated barehanded (no weapon) on four players
C3 in Trapper's Folly needs level 15 Trapping on five players each interacting with the star
C4 in Refrigeration Station bottom left needs AFK 60 consecutive hours on three players
C5 in Rollin' Tundra bottom right needs reaching Wave 11 of the tower defense totem on four characters
C6 in Thermonuclear Climb bottom right needs AFK at least 11 hours on nine characters
C7 at far right of Crystal Base Camp needs six characters to reach the star
C8 at far right of Hell Hath Frozen Over needs a Blood Bone killed on four players
D1 top left of Outer World Town needs standing on the roof and level 120 on eight players interacting on each
D2 bottom left of Space Way Raceway needs all Mushrooms defeated before any respawn on three players
D3 in Donut Drive-in below the piggy needs level 15 Cooking on four players
D4 in Worm Highway needs reaching the star on three players
D5 in Coco Tunnel center needs all Choccies defeated before respawn on four players
D6 in Standstill Plains near exit portal needs four players to reach the star
D8 in Shelled Shores needs a megacrit on a Clammy on four players
Megacrit requires the Star Talent Book Megacrit from the Dungeons Flurbo Shop
